note: Roadmap built from the official trophy descriptions and the published guides cited in trophies.json (GTABase, PowerPyx). One playthrough, no online play, about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10.

stages.detail: Play Chapters 1 to 5 in order and collect the 12 story trophies as they come: Gone Fishing, the four chapter trophies, the final mission gold, and the mission trophies Breakfast Run, The Cartel Heist, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and Operation Savage Glory. Do the side content that shows up along the way — Kenton's shipwrecks in Chapter 1, Cal's fishing, Billy's jobs after Coffee Break — since many quests are only offered for a while.
items: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
stages.title: Stage 1 — Play the story, Chapters 1–5

stages.detail: Only one trophy in the whole list may be missable, and it lives here. In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. That spot is gone after Chapter 1 and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it — so do not skip it. Also steer clear of the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent. Turn on every progress and collectible notification in the settings.
stages.title: Stage 2 — Protect the one missable trophy

stages.detail: With both characters together, scan vehicles and WAiNK spots as you travel, meditate at every spot with both characters, and finish the character quest lines: Andy (Lucia-only, Chapter 3), Kenton (7 shipwrecks), Billy (5 jobs), Randy (16 sports cars), Tyrone (labs, Jason-only) and Bret (Target Decks). Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands for Strangers & Freaks — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses, Yasmani and Eddie do not.
stages.title: Stage 3 — Side characters, strangers and scanning

stages.detail: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and work the checklist category by category. Needed in full: all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, all 42 Shooting Range golds, all 42 drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks. In part: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. This is the longest stage — around 100 hours — and most of the miscellaneous trophies pop along the way.
stages.title: Stage 4 — The 100% checklist (A Long Road)

stages.detail: Sweep up what is left: win 20 different races, finish an arcade game, beat Cal's fishing challenge, try every activity type, earn the partner trophies (4-star escape, 3 shops back-to-back), rob a jewelry store unseen, steal the VCIA jet and the Rhino tank, take 5 enemies down in one Combat Focus, max Strength for both characters, buy the 8 garages, register 10 vehicles, spend $100,000 in shops and complete 3 card sets. The five trophies whose steps no guide has confirmed yet — In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Bad Luck, I Guess, The Truth Is Out There and Ten Pin — are flagged in the checklist; check the cited guides for updates.
stages.title: Stage 5 — Cleanup: races, robberies and one-offs

stages.detail: Once the other 54 are earned, the platinum unlocks on its own. No DLC, no online play and no second playthrough are needed.
stages.title: Stage 6 — Platinum: Vice Got a Price!
